description: Sender headers (operator prefix and TRAI suffix ignored), and each kind of result.

rules.pattern: Sent (?<amount>(?:Rs\.?|INR|₹)\s?[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) from Test Bank A/c X?(?<account>\d{4}) to (?<payee>.+?) on (?<date>\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{2})\. ?UPI Ref:? ?(?<ref>\d+)

cases.name: prefix and service suffix
cases.body: Sent Rs.366.00 from Test Bank A/c X1234 to GENERAL STORE on 23-09-26. UPI Ref 111122223333. Not done by you? Tap https://example.com/fraud
